description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'Plugins_InvocationTags' for invocation tag plugins in the Revive Adserver project. It includes class properties, abstract methods, and functions for managing invocation tags, options, and HTML generation.

classes.name: Plugins_InvocationTags
classes.description: An abstract class for invocation tag plugins, providing methods for options management, HTML generation, and invocation code preparation.

methods.name: getNameEN
methods.description: Abstract method to return the plugin's English name.

methods.name: getOptionsList
methods.description: Abstract method to return a list of plugin options.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the plugin is allowed based on configuration settings.

methods.name: canGenerate
methods.description: Checks if the plugin has enough data to generate tags.

methods.name: getHeaderHtml
methods.description: Returns HTML to display after the invocation tags dropdown.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the display order of the plugin.

methods.name: setInvocation
methods.description: Injects the invocation object into the plugin.

methods.name: generateInvocationCode
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the invocation string.

methods.name: prepareCommonInvocationData
methods.description: Prepares data before generating invocation code, setting parameters, comments, and backup images.
